Frequently Asked Questions
What can I expect from the initial consultation visit?
Once your appointment is booked, we will bring our practice to you!  We come equipped with supplies to collect bloodwork, ultrasound images, and more. After the initial happy to see you wiggles are over, Dr. Harris will perform a head-to-toe exam.
Once we have completed our assessment of your pet, Dr. Harris will explain her findings and we will work together to come up with a treatment plan that makes sense for you and your pet.
Is a referral required?
A referral from your veterinarian is required to schedule a mobile visit. Telemedicine appointments can be scheduled without a referral but we will need to collect and review all relevant medical records before the consult.  Please have your veterinarian send your pet’s complete medical records to DrHarrisCancerVet@gmail.com to fulfill this requirement.
I live outside of Austin.  Will you come to my house?
If you live outside the Austin City Limits, please contact us and provide your address so that we can determine if you’re in our service area.  We do see patients in the greater Austin Metropolitan area and are happy to work with you to find a solution.  There may be an additional fee for mobile visits outside the Austin area.
What diagnostics do you offer?
Routine bloodwork & urinalysis
Vitamin level testing
Ultrasound- abdominal, thoracic, cervical
Fine needle aspirates (FNA) with cytology review
Lymphoma drug sensitivity testing
Genomic Testing of canine tumors to guide Precision therapy option
BRAF testing for urinary tract cancer
Liquid biopsies for monitoring response to therapy
Liquid biopsies for cancer screening in healthy pets
